title_en: Reasons for the Lag in the Science of Exegesis within the Seminaries
description_en: Reasons for the lag in the science of exegesis within the seminaries from the lessons of His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari
summary: Analyzes the historical and structural reasons behind the delayed development of Quranic exegesis as a primary discipline in the seminaries (hawza).
